mapper.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.seller_id, o.schedule_id, o.total_amount, o.status, o.channel, o.create_time, o.pay_time, r.route_name, r.depart_port, r.arrive_port, sh.ship_name, s.depart_time FROM orders o JOIN schedule s ON o.schedule_id = s.id JOIN route r ON s.route_id = r.id JOIN ship sh ON s.ship_id = sh.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, seller_id, schedule_id, total_amount, status, channel) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{sellerId}, #{scheduleId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{channel})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'UNPAID'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'PAID', pay_time = #{payTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'UNPAID'
UPDATE orders SET total_amount = #{totalAmount}, schedule_id = #{scheduleId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE orders SET status = 'FINISHED' WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND status = 'CHECKED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{status}
SELECT id, order_no, user_id, seller_id, schedule_id, total_amount, status, channel, create_time, pay_time FROM orders WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND status IN ('PAID','CHECKED')
SELECT id, order_no, user_id, seller_id, schedule_id, total_amount, status, channel, create_time, pay_time FROM orders WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status IN ('PAID','CHECKED','FINISHED')
